Commentary.Commentary: ENGLAND HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON! The hosts have managed to wrap things up quickly courtesy a wicket from Broad and a run out. The Windies did manage to add some quick runs after the break but it was never going to be enough. Blackwood was their lone warrior fighting it out there but he ran out of partners. The away side still trails by another 346 runs and they would want to put up a better batting performance than they did in the first innings. Join us for the third innings in a while.

OUT! WESTLEY WRAPS IT UP! Superb fielding from England's no.3 batsman and that's the end of Cummins. Length ball around off stump, Blackwood wanted the single badly and nudges it towards the leg side before setting off for the run. Westley is quick to attack the ball and fires a direct hit at the striker's end. Cummins is short and replays confirm the same. WEST INDIES HAVE BEEN SHOT OUT FOR 168.
Almost dragged on! Good length ball around off stump, Blackwood tries to push at it but gets an inside edge that just past the leg stump.
Fuller ball around middle, gets across and clips it through mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Back of a length ball closer to off stump, Blackwood opens the face to dab it wide of the slip cordon for a boundary. Was fairly in control on this occasion.
On a good length on off stump, defended firmly off the back foot.

Uppish but in the gap! Full toss around off stump, takes Blackwood by surprise as he pushes at it with an angled bat. It flies off the splice well wide of the man at point to the deep. He refuses the single.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Miguel Cummins is the next man in.

OUT! That looked pretty straight! Broad gets his second. Fuller in length on middle, straightens a little. joseph tries to flick it but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. England appeal and the umpire gives it out. He played all-around that one. West Indies are 9 down now and they need another 153 to avoid the follow-on.
Back of a length around off, Alzarri punches it to covers.
Shorter in length outside off, Joseph lets it through to the keeper.
A tad fuller on middle, Blackwood plays it to mid on for a run, leaving Alzarri four balls to face.
Back of a length on middle, JB punches it to Moeen Ali at cover-point.
Angles it on the pads, Alzarri defends it towards mid on.
LOVELY STUFF! Bowls it on a length, straightens a touch. Alzarri tries to defend but gets beaten.
Length ball on off, Joseph defends it towards mid off.
A surprise short delivery by Anderson. Joseph does well to duck under it.
Anderson keeps hitting the length around off, Alzarri plants his front foot ahead and defends it.
Good length angling into the batsman. Joseph defends it solidly.
Blackwood has started with a bang after lunch. He has already cracked two boundaries and an emphatic biggie. Seems determined to unsettle the bowlers.
Three in a row! Shorter in length but outside off this time. Blackwood watches it go through to the keeper.
Another short ball, JB ducks under it again.
Bangs it in short on middle, Blackwood ducks under it. He has not been comfortable with short stuff.
Good length on off, JB tries to clip it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Lands it on a length on middle, Blackwood defends it off the back foot.
SIX! Where did that come from? Blackwood makes room, Broad follows him with a full ball on leg stump. JB flicks it over the wide long on fence for a maximum. He is on the charge here.
FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! A touch shorter in length outside off, Joseph rocks back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. Useful runs for the Windies.
Bowls it on a length on off, Joseph defends it off the front foot. He looks good while playing the defense.
Length ball, jagging back into the batsman. Blackwood nudges it to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length outside off, JB guides it to point.
Lands it on a length on off, Blackwood gets behind the line and blocks it.
Good length on off, gets some extra bounce. Blackwood defends it off the splice towards the off side.
James Anderson will bowl from the other end.
Lands it on a length on off, Joseph defends it confidently.
Square leg drops back. He might bowl some short stuff here.
Bowls it very full on middle, Joseph gets it out off the middle of the bat to mid-wicket.
BEATEN AGAIN! Good length around off, straightens a touch. Joseph hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
A tad fuller outside off, stays a touch low. Joseph tries to force it on the off side but gets beaten.
A tad shorter on off, JB punches it to mid off and takes a single.
FOUR! A good way to start the session for the Windies. Back of a length outside off, Blackwood camps back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary. He will look to add some quick runs here.
We're back for the second session. Blackwood and Joseph will continue their innings. Broad will continue after the break.
...Day 3, Session 2...

This session - 25 overs, 101 runs and 7 wickets. The Windies are staring down the barrel. They are in all sorts of trouble going into lunch. The English bowlers have ran through the visitors' batting line-up, with everybody except Ben Stokes chipping in at the wickets. Nobody barring for Blackwood, who is unbeaten on 60, has provided any resistance. The English bowlers would want to come out and take the remaining two wickets as quick as possible. It would be interesting to see if England do enforce the follow-on. Join us for the second session in a while.
Flatter on off, Joseph defends it off the back foot and survives the last ball before the break. THAT WILL BE LUNCH ON DAY 3!
Loopy ball outside off, Blackwood drives it through the cover region for a run.
Flighted ball outside off, Blackwood drives it to cover.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
SIX! BANG! Excellent use of the feet by Blackwood who shimmies down the track and hits the flighted delivery over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Floats it up on off, Blackwood opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a couple.
Angles it into the pads, Joseph gets it off the inner half through backward square leg for a couple.
Alzarri Joseph walks into bat.

OUT! KABOOM! The bowling change works wonders. Broad cleans Roach up. Full ball tailing in on off, Roach goes for the drive but the ball goes between bat and pad and knocks the off stump. West Indies are 8 down and they still need another 181 to avoid the follow-on.
Bangs in a short ball on off, Roach lets it through to the keeper.
Fuller in length outside off, Roach drives it to covers.
Length ball outside off stump, left alone to the keeper.
On a good length around the fifth stump channel, left alone to the keeper.
Stuart Broad is back into the attack.
Shorter in length outside off, Roach cuts it to point and runs a single.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Slashes and slashes hard. Full outside off, Roach hits it through backward point for a boundary.
Kemar Roach strides out to the middle.

OUT! Bairstow is right! An excellent review from England and all credit must be given to Jonny. Moeen Ali gets his man. He beat Holder's outside edge several times in his last over but gets it this time. Tosses it up outside off, Holder goes for the drive but he appears to have gotten something and that makes Bairstow excited. The English players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Jonny wants to review and he asks the captain to. Root obliges and they go upstairs. Ultra Edge shows there was a little spike as the ball passes the bat. The umpire has to change his decision. Holder is not happy and he kicks the surface as he walks back. Moeen Ali is into the wickets again.
England have opted to review for a caught behind against Holder. Bairstow feels there is an edge.
Tosses it up on off, Blackwood drives it through the covers for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
10th Test fifty for Blackwood.

He finally gets to his fifty. He was itching for that run and he gets it this time. Angles it on the stumps, Blackwood hits it towards mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A single added to the total. This has been a very good innings by Blackwood. He has come out and played his shots.
Shorter in length outside off, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood taps it on the off side and wants a run but is sent back by Holder.
Bouncer again! Blackwood this time ducks under it.
Lands it on a length on off, Blackwood defends it solidly.
Bangs it in short outside off, Blackwood does well to evade him. They are targeting him with the short ball as he has not looked comfortable.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
AGAIN! Floats it on off, Holder tries to go big but gets beaten. He is struggling to adjust to the drift.
Quicker outside off, skids through. Holder gets beaten on the outside for the third time in a row. He is struggling to pick him.
Tosses it outside off, gets some drift away from the batsman. Holder tries to play the expansive drive but does not connect.
Bowls it full outside off, Holder tries to drive it but the ball stays a touch low and he gets beaten. It hits Bairstow on his pads and rolls towards the off side.
Flatter on off, Holder pushes it back to the bowler.
Moeen Ali is into the attack.
Shortish length outside off, JB camps back and pushes it through the off side for a couple.

Bangs it in short to Blackwood, who takes it on with an awkward-looking pull. The ball goes just over the short backward square leg fielder which was brought in just before this ball. That move almost paid off.
Chris Woakes is on the field for Stuart Broad.
Drifts it on the pads, Holder flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Holder drives it beautifully to mid off.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff! Lands it on a length around off, nips away. Holder pokes at it and gets beaten.
Lands it on a length on off, Holder defends it solidly.
FOUR! Take that Toby! Fuller in length on middle, Blackwood drives it uppishly straight back over the bowler's head and the ball races to the fence. He has raced on to 45.
STIFLED APPEAL! Nothing from the umpire. Lands it on a length outside off, jags back in. Blackwood gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Blackwood is not happy with his bat. He is asking for a change. He might have broken it while playing the last shot.
Back of a length on middle, JB defends it to silly mid on.
Goes wider of the crease and angles it into the pads, Holder flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
EDGY FOUR! Another one which goes off the edge. Full on off, Holder tries to drive it through the off side but gets it off the outer half through backward point for a boundary.
Fuller on the stumps, Holder shuffles across and squirts it to mid-wicket.
Angles it onto the pads, Holder flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Bangs in another short one. Blackwood pulls it this time down to fine leg for a run.
BOUNCER! A well-directed one. JB does well to evade it.
Length ball, jags back into the batsman. Blackwood tries to defend but gets hit on the box. There is a muted appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Almost another drag on. Just short of a length outside off, Blackwood tries to force it through the off side but gets an under edge onto his pads and the ball rolls besides the pitch.
Bowls a very full ball, almost a yorker on middle, Holder does well to dig it out.
Lands it on a length on middle, Holder defends it confidently.
Sprays it down the leg side, Holder tries to flick it but misses. He should have put that away.
A tad fuller on off, Holder pushes it to cover off the front foot.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Bowls a good follow-up delivery. Stokes lands it on a length outside off, Holder tries to defend but gets beaten.
FOUR! Streaky but Holder won't mind. Back of a length outside off, Holder tries to force if through the off side off the back foot but gets an outside edge through backward point for a boundary.
BEATEN! Stokes bowls it on a length around off, nips away a touch. Holder tries to poke at it and gets beaten.
Sprays it on the pads, Blackwood flicks it on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Bowls it on the pads, Blackwood flicks it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood flicks it to mid-wicket.
Jason Holder comes out to bat.

OUT! That is as plumb as it can get! Shane Dowrich's dreadful stay comes to an end. He never looked comfortable and he is walking back now. Toby angles it on middle and straightens it a touch to hit Dowrich on his back pad. He looks at the non-striker whether to review or not but his partner turns his back immediately. The English players go up and the umpire gives it out. The Windies are in dire straits now.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sprays it down the leg side, Dowrich tries flicking it but misses and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper.
EDGY FOUR! Fuller on off, Dowrich prods forward and tries to drive it but gets an outside edge through the slip cordon for a boundary.
A tad fuller on off, JB times it nicely towards extra cover. He initially calls no but then wants a run and they complete it.
Fullish length on middle, Blackwood drives it to mid on.
Shorter in length, Dowrich tries to defend it but gets an outside edge which falls short of second slip.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood gets it off the inner half towards square leg for a run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! That blow surely has not shaken him up! Stokes bangs it in short outside off this time. Blackwood gets into the position and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Blackwood cops a blow on the helmet. He looks okay, but the physio is out to have a check.

SNORTER! That hit him flush on the helmet. Stokes bangs it in short on middle, Blackwood tries to duck under it but is late and the ball hits the helmet and rolls towards the off side. Ben Stokes goes up to the batsman to ask him whether he is fine or not. Good sportsmanship from the all-rounder.
Angles it into the pads, Blackwood clips it with the willow through mid-wicket for a couple.
Good length on off, Dowrich defends it off the front foot.
Shane Dowrich is the new man in.
Drinks has been taken. England are all over the Windies at the moment.

OUT! Timber! Toby Roland-Jones strikes. Another drag on. Maybe shades of the wicket getting a little slow? The bowler bowls it a tad fuller outside off, Hope goes for the expansive drive away from the body but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. These two were stitching some sort of a partnership but Hope has to walk back. West Indies have lost half their side and they are still trailing by 425 runs.
Lands it on a length on off, SH defends it solidly.
Just ahead of a length around middle and off, Blackwood gets it off the inner half through square leg for a run.
Fullish on middle, the batsman eases it to mid on.
Full on the stumps, Blackwood times it beautifully to mid on.
Angles it onto the pads, Blackwood flicks it through the leg side to keep strike.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Back of a length outside off, Blackwood rocks back and pushes it through the off side for a boundary. This is good counter-attack from the Windies.
Shortish outside off, Blackwood camps back and guides it through backward point and the batsmen take two.
Lands it on a length on off, Blackwood defends it off the front foot.
A tad fuller on middle, Blackwood drives it to mid on.
Shorter in length outside off, Blackwood sees the width on offer and he hits it through cover-point for a couple.
A tad fuller on off, Hope lunges forward and drives it to mid on.
Good length on off, Hope defends it solidly.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A brave leave there! Good length outside off, jags back in after pitching. Hope covers the off stump and lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Roland-Jones bowls it outside off, Hope tries to force it through the off side but gets it off the outer half through backward point for a boundary.
Bowls a yorker on off, Hope does well to jam it out.
Good length outside off, Hope gets it off the outer half past a diving Anderson at gully. The fielder from second slip gives it a chase and saves a run for his team.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Hope covers the line of the ball and defends it.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Short of a length outside off, Hope gets into the position and square cuts it through point for a boundary.
Bowls it outside off, Hope lets it be.
Ben Stokes is into the attack.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
FOUR! Roland-Jones bowls an overpitched delivery on off, Blackwood drives it through mid off for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls it very wide outside off, Blackwood lets it through to the keeper. The umpire signals a wide.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Almost dragged it on! A full toss outside off, Blackwood goes hard at it and gets an inside edge which goes just past the stumps and down to fine leg for two.
Bowls an away swinger outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full ball on middle, Blackwood times the ball down the ground to the long on fence. That was a cracking shot by the batsman.
Toby Roland-Jones comes into the attack.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length on off, Hope defends it to mid off.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it solidly.

FOUR! STREAKY BOUNDARY! Good length on off, straightens a touch. Hope tries to defend off the back foot but gets a thick outside edge between the slips and gully to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it.
Lands it on a length outside off, Hope points his bat skywards and lets it through.
FOUR! Shortish outside off, Blackwood stands tall and punches it through the off side for a boundary.
Back of a length on off, Blackwood defends it off the back foot.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, Blackwood camps back and pushes it through the off side. The fielder from point gives it a chase and does well to keep it down to two.
Just short of a length outside off, the ball bounces more than Blackwood expected. He goes at it with hard hands but it goes uppishly and lands short of the fielder at point.
Anderson bowls it on a length on off, Blackwood defends it watchfully.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Back to bowling length on off, Hope plants his front foot ahead and defends it.
He bowls a wide full ball, inviting the batsman to drive. Hope obliges but gets beaten as he tries to force it through the off side.
Good length on off, Hope defends it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it solidly.
This is lovely, lovely bowling from the English pacers. Broad from wide of the crease angles it on off, the ball straightens after pitching and beats the outside edge of Hope.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Jermaine Blackwood is the next batsman in, replacing Chase. It's really windy out there and the king of swing, James Anderson has his tail up against the Windies now...

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Chase, their in-form batsman is walking back to the hut. Anderson bowls an inswinger this time. He lands it on a length outside off, nips back in. Chase tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an inside edge and drags it on to the stumps. A big wicket for England here. Anderson gets his third. He is on top of his game.
Bowls it outside off, the batsman lets it through to the keeper.
A tad fuller swinging away on off, Chase first thinks of playing at it but then leaves it but the ball takes the bottom edge and goes onto the bounce to second slip.
A well-directed bouncer there. Chase does well to evade it. That surely must have surprised him.
Bowls it very full on off, giving it every chance to swing. Chase plants his front foot ahead and drives it to mid off.
Lands it on a length on off, Hope defends it by covering the line.
Bowls an away swinger outside off, Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Angles it into the pads, Hope clips it to mid-wicket.

BEAUTY! Broad bowls it from wide of the crease and lands it on a length around off, the ball straightens a touch after pitching. Hope tries to defend it but gets beaten. That was really close to the outside edge.
Full and wide outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it. There was a little movement after the ball passed the batsman.
Good length outside off, Hope lunges forward and defends it.

Inside edge saves Chase here! Anderson is bowling a superb spell. Once again pitches it on off, it jags back in sharply as Roston prods forward to defend. It hits him on the pads and there's a loud appeal in unison from the Englishmen. The umpire shakes his head as he spots the inside edge. Good decision!
Hurls it on a length outside off, easily left alone.
Fuller and coming back in from around off, it's defended gently from within the crease.

That was close! Hits it on a length and gets it to curl back in, Chase looks to defend but is cramped for room. Gets an inside edge and the ball rolls back towards the stumps. Luckily, it doesn't disturb the timber.
Fires in a yorker on middle and off, it's jammed out towards backward point.
Fuller and swinging away, Chase makes an easy leave.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Roston Chase is the next man in!

OUT! Gone! That was completely needless there by Powell. Fuller ball on off, Powell drives it straight to the man at mid on and sets off for a run. Anderson stationed there does well to run to his right, picks up the ball with one hand and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. They all appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs. Replays shows Powell was way short of his crease and OUT! flashes on the big screen. The Windies have lost two in six balls. A dreadful start for them today and they are in all sorts of trouble.
Drama! Sheer drama! It's a direct hit at the bowler's end from Anderson and Powell seems to be struggling here. It's taken upstairs...
Sprays it on the pads, Powell flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Angles it into the pads, Powell tucks it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length on middle, Powell defends it off the back foot.

NOT OUT! England lose a review! Broad bowls a full inswinger on middle, Powell falls over while trying to flick and the ball raps him on the pads. The English players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. After a discussion with his teammates, Root opts to review. They go upstairs and the ball is just clipping the leg stump and the umpire's call stays.
A loud shout for LBW. It's not given. England take the review against Powell. Is it going down leg?
Stuart Broad will bowl from the other end. Three slips and a gully for him...
Shai Hope strides in next.

OUT! An ideal start for England! The extra bounce does Hope in there. Anderson comes running in, bowls it on a length on off, Hope tries to block it but the ball gets big on him. It takes the shoulder of the bat and goes to Ben Stokes at gully who pouches it. He dropped one yesterday but makes no mistake this time. Hope who showed good promise, departs early.
Back of a length swinging away on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Angles it into the pads, Hope clips it with the willow to mid-wicket.
Drifts it on the pads, Powell tries to flick it but misses, the ball brushes the thigh pad and rolls towards square leg. The batsmen take a leg bye.
BEATEN! Good ball there by Anderson! Lands it on a length angling across Powell who pokes at it and gets beaten.
We're back after the delay. It is still windy. Anderson will continue his over.
1342 local update - GOOD NEWS! The rain has eased off and the play will resume at 1400 local. The second session will be extended by half an hour.

1330 local - That's really sad! A false start to the day and we are really sorry to bring in this to you. It's absolutely bucketing down at Edgbaston and off go the players. The groundsmen run in with the covers. Don't want to disappoint you, but it has gone quite murky out there. Let's hope this clears out soon. Stay with us as we will keep you posted...
Anderson is right on the money. He bowls a fuller ball on off, Powell prods forward and defends it confidently.

We're ready to get underway for the first session. There is a little rain in the air but does not look that threatening. Powell and Hope will continue their innings. James Anderson will be the one who will steam in first up. He's given three slips and a gully...

Hello and welcome to the third day which is also known as the moving day of a Test match between England and West Indies at Edgbaston. We witnessed a nearly perfect day for the hosts before it was intervened by rain yesterday. They still will be very happy with their position and would try to make quick work of this fragile West Indian batting line-up. The visitors on the other hand, still trail by another 470 runs and they will need all their batsmen to apply themselves on a pitch which is still good for batting to cut down the deficit. The weather forecast for today is quite promising and we can hope for a full day's play. Let us hope for an action-packed day of cricket. Stay tuned as the action is about to start.
...Day 3, Session 1...

Earlier in the day, England made sure they put up a daunting total on the board with Cook smashing a brilliant 243. The Windies have already lost a wicket and are still a long way behind in this game. However, the current pair has battled out the day and survived through the tricky period with assistance of rain. They will come out tomorrow hoping that they can put up a good fight. We will have a 30-minute early start at 1330 local (1230 GMT). Let's hope the weather stays clear and we get a full day's play. Goodbye and take care!
2010 local time update - The rain gods have not relented which has forced the match officials to call it a day. IT IS STUMPS ON DAY 2.

1930 local time - Bad news, folks! Both the umpires come together for a discussion and they feel that the rain has gotten pretty heavy for play to continue and on COME THE COVERS. We could be in for a long delay as the conditions at present aren't promising...
Good length outside off, Hope first thinks of playing at it but then pulls the bat out of the way.
Fuller on the pads, Powell nudges it towards mid-wicket for a run.
The heavens have opened up at Edgbaston. The groundsmen are ready with the covers, probably waiting for the call from the umpire...
Angles it into the pads, Powell flicks it through square leg and they run two.
FOUR! That was beautifully timed! A tad fuller on off, Powell plants his front foot ahead and drives it through the covers and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length outside off, skids off the surface. Powell guides it to point.
Good length outside off, Powell watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Hope opts not to play at it.
Angles it into the batsman who flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, swinging away. Hope shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it solidly.
Fullish on off, Hope times his drive brilliantly through mid off for a brace.
FOUR! Good length outside off, Hope camps back and punches it uppishly through covers and the ball races to the fence on this lightning fast outfield.
FOUR! That was beautifully timed! Fullish on middle, Powell just flicks it with ease through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Length outside off, Powell does not fiddle with it.
Good length outside off, Powell lets it be.
A tad fuller outside off, gets some away swing. Powell plays inside the line of the ball and lets it through to the keeper.
It has gotten really dark out there and a bit of rain is in the air too. Please stay away...
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on a length around off, Powell camps back and defends it to covers.
Angles it into the pads, Hope tucks it away on the leg side for a run.
BEAUTY! It is a treat to watch him bowl. Fullish length on off, nipping away. Powell pokes at it and gets beaten. This is top, top quality bowling from the English seamers.
A tad fuller on leg stump, Powell pushes it towards mid on.
Sprays it down the leg side, Powell misses the flick and it goes through to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Powell shoulders his arms to it.
Bowls it on middle, Powell flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Lands it on a length outside off, straightens a touch. Powell tries to drive it away from the body but gets beaten.
Bangs it in short on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Hope guides it to point.

FOUR! Broad is bowling without any luck here! Bowls a good length ball, it skids on and takes the outside edge and falls just short of Moeen Ali at third slip who lets it go underneath his hands. The ball races to the third man fence. Stuart Broad is frustrated as he lets out a loud roar.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Broad bangs it in short but the ball does not bounce that much. Hope stands tall and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. He picked the length early there.
Drifts it on the pads, Hope clips it off his hips through square leg and runs a brace.
Good length on middle, Hope pushes it to mid on.

Bowls an inswinger on middle and on a length, jags back in a touch. Powell looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. The Englishmen make a loud appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Might be going over.
Length ball angling across the batsman. Powell shoulders his arms to it.
A tad fuller on off, Hope pushes it towards covers and runs a single.
Angles it into the pads, Hope shuffles across and flicks it towards mid-wicket who makes a good half stop. No runs conceded.
Good length on off, Hope defends it by covering the line of the stumps.
Anderson starts off the session with a loosener on the pads, Powell flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Wider of the off stump this time. Hope shoulders his arms to it. A good first over after the break from Broad.
Length ball on off, Hope defends it watchfully.
Back of a length on off, Hope guides it to point.
Good length ball outside off, straightens off the deck. Hope pokes at it and gets beaten.

Similar length ball on off, Powell taps it in front of covers and sets off. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. A run is added to the total. Replays show a direct hit and it would have been curtains for Hope.
Good length on off, angling into the batsman. Powell prods forward and defends it solidly.
We're ready to get underway. Powell and Hope will continue their innings. Broad will bowl the first over after the break.
...Day 2, Session 3...

England have managed to pick a wicket in the nine overs bowled by them. It would have been two, had  Stokes not dropped a catch at gully. The West Indian batsmen look in all sorts of trouble out there with the ball doing all kinds of things. With overcast conditions and with the flood lights coming into play, the visitors are going to have a tough time. Join us shortly for the last session.
Prods ahead to a full ball and pats it into the cover region for a single. TEA ON DAY 2!
Pretty harmless delivery, served outside off, Kieran decides to let it through.
Fuller and once again brings it back in, worked towards mid-wicket.
Brings it back into Powell who shuffles a bit and defends it back to the bowler.
Keeps it in the channel outside off, Powell shoulders his arms to it.
Slants it away on a length outside off, in that nagging zone. Powell plays and misses.
On a fuller length and it's swinging away, Hope offers no shot.
Nasser Hussain on air mentions James Anderson opted for length deliveries in the first over but soon changed it to bowling a little full as he got more swing and hence got the wicket.
On a length and outside off, Shai Hope defends it with a straight blade.
A bit fuller and served outside off, tight back foot defense from Hope.
Drops it on a good length and it jags back in with some bounce and takes Hope aback. He misses it completely and wears it high on the pads.
Wide outside off, Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Good length on off, Powell taps it in front of point and takes a quick run.
JAFFA! Full and swinging away outside off, Hope tries to drive it but gets beaten. Lucky it did not take the outside edge there.
Back of a length on off, Hope defends it off the back foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
WIDE! Fullish length and very wide of off stump, Hope lets it through to the keeper who makes a good diving stop to his right. The umpire signals that as a wide.
Full and very wide outside off, swings away further. Hope points his bat skywards and lets it through.
BEAUTY! Lands it on a length on off, swings away. Hope pokes at it and gets beaten. Anderson is getting a lot of swing here.
A tad fuller outside off, Hope shoulders his arms to it.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell does not opt to fiddle with it.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Angles it into the pads, Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket for a run.

DROPPED BY STOKES! You don't see that often. Fuller ball on off, swinging away. Powell tries to drive but gets an outside edge which flies to Stokes at gully who is late to react and drops it. The ball rolls towards short third man and the batsmen take a run. Ben Stokes should have taken that.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell does not offer a shot to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length on middle, Hope defends it off the front foot.

Another appeal! Again bowls the inswinger on middle, Hope tries to clip it through the leg side but misses and is struck on the pads. There is a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Might be missing leg. Hope is not comfortable  with the inswingers.
Good length on middle, jags back in a touch. Hope tries to flick but misses and is struck on the thigh pad.
Bowls it on the pads, Powell flicks it through square leg for a run.
LOVELY STUFF! Similar length on off, getting the ball to shape away from the left-hander. Powell is beaten on the outside edge.
A tad fuller on off, nips away. Powell pokes at it and gets beaten.
Darker clouds are coming in. Not good signs here. There was rain forecast for the last session.
Bowls it a bit wider outside off, Shai Hope watches it go through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length outside off, it triggers back in sharply as Hope covers the sticks to leave it alone.
Broad hits the deck hard, Hope arches back to evade it.
Fuller and sprayed down the leg side, Hope tries to flick it away but fails to do so.
Angles in on the hips, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Broad pitches it up but this time it's wide outside off, Powell lifts his bat to leave it alone.
Full outside off, Hope leans into it and drives it through covers for a couple.
FOUR! Anderson bowls it on the pads, a very juicy overpitched delivery for Hope to get off the mark. He flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.

BIG APPEAL! Bowls an inswinger this time, Hope shuffles across and tries to flick but misses and the ball hits him on the pads. The England players appeal and the umpire gives it not out. They also opt not to review as Root thought height could be the issue. But replays show that it was going on to clip the leg pole. That was really close!
A tad fuller outside off, Hope lets it through to the keeper.
Kyle Hope walks in next, replacing Brathwaite.

OUT! WHAT A START! An absolute ripper of a delivery from Anderson and Brathwaite's dismal form continues. Anderson bowls it full on off, swinging away. Kraigg pokes at it and gets an outside edge to Bairstow behind the stumps who makes no mistake. A perfect start for England and Anderson is pumped. First one down for West Indies.
A tad fuller on off, Brathwaite drives it to mid off.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Lands it on a length outside off, Powell lets it be.
Good length outside off, Powell does not fiddle with it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Lands it on a length on middle, Powell defends it solidly.

Almost induces the edge on his first ball! Very full outside off, gets great shape away from the batsman. Powell plants his front foot ahead and tries to drive it but gets beaten. A nervous shot there by Powell, should have left that ball being his first delivery. Broad has some words to share with Powell.
Stuart Broad to share the new ball with Anderson. Three slips and a gully in place...
On the fourth stump channel, Brathwaite points his bat skywards and lets it through. A maiden to start with by Anderson.
Bowls it a touch straighter this time, Brathwaite gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it.
A tad fuller outside off, swinging away. Brathwaite plays inside the line and lets it through to the keeper.
In the cordon of uncertainty, the batsman does not opt to play at it.
Similar length ball outside off, Brathwaite shoulders his arms to it.
Starts off on a length just outside off, does not get a lot of swing. Brathwaite watchfully lets it through to the keeper.
